examples.arabic: أم كريم، التي كانت تحضر الحقائب بحماس، شعرت بقلقٍ يتسلل إلى قلبها وهي ترى السحب تتجمع بسرعة.
examples.english: Um Karim, who was eagerly preparing the bags, felt anxiety creeping into her heart as she saw the clouds gathering quickly.
examples.transliteration: Um Karim, allati kanat tuhaddir al-haqa'ib bi-hamas, sha'arat bi-qalaqin yatasallal ila qalb-ha wa hiya tara as-suhub tatajamma' bi-sur'a.

examples.arabic: جيراني بسرعة صاروا يثبّتوا أثاثهم الخارجي، وسحبوا ولادهم لجوا بعيداً عن هبات الريح المفاجئة.
examples.english: My neighbors quickly started securing their outdoor furniture and pulled their children inside away from the sudden gusts of wind.
examples.transliteration: jeerani b-sor'a saaro ythabbitu athaathhom el-khaariji, w sahabu wlaadhom la-jau ba'eeda 'an habbaat er-reeh el-mufaaj'a.

examples.arabic: لينا بسرعة حَسَبِت إنهم رح يقدروا يشتروا أشياء كتير تانية إذا دبروا مصاريهم منيح وما صرفوا كتير على شي واحد.
examples.english: Lina quickly calculated that they would be able to buy many other things if they managed their money well and didn't spend too much on one item.
examples.transliteration: Leena b-sur'a hasabit innahom rah yiqdaru yishtaru ashyaa' kteer taniyeh iza dabbaroo masarihom mneeh w ma sarrafo kteer 'ala shi wahed.
examples.storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

examples.arabic: وقف سامي بنص الساحة وقلبه كان عم يدق بسرعة.
examples.english: Sami stood in the middle of the square and his heart was beating fast.
examples.transliteration: Waqaf Sami be-nuss as-saha wa qalbo kan am yiduqq be-sur-a.

examples.arabic: شربت قهوتي الدافية بسرعة وانا عم حضر حالي لعاصفة
examples.english: I drank my warm coffee quickly while I was preparing myself for a storm
examples.transliteration: Shribit qahwiti al dafiye bi sura w ana am haddir hali la aasifa

examples.arabic: الموظف كان مشغول بس ساعدني بسرعه
examples.english: The employee was busy but he helped me quickly.
examples.transliteration: el mowazzaf kan mashghool bas saaedni bseraa
